name: adhd-friendly
description: Keeps replies short, actionable and consistently shaped: a per-prompt Reply Card, a silent Reply Meter, and a bundled ADHD output style.

cardTiers.title: Card tier thresholds
cardTiers.description: Reply Card tier thresholds as "oneLine,full" word counts. A prompt of oneLine words or fewer gets the one-line card; a question, or a prompt longer than full words, gets the whole card; anything else gets the shape half.

meter.title: Reply meter
meter.description: Score each finished reply and log it to meter.log. Off means the Stop hook logs nothing and the next card carries no violation line.

strictness.title: Meter strictness
strictness.description: How hard the meter scores: "lenient" counts only the shape rules, "normal" counts the full STE set, "strict" adds the house spelling and dash counts.
